claims.title: Acquire a conservative cascade and compute its rare conditional paths

quoted_fields.interface: The supplied completed source learns one-sided rate tables and useful scopes despite dense weak monotone interactions,constructs a width decomposition and positive event-time compiler,then reconstructs continuous drivers with rarity-independent probability/conditional-path bounds.
quoted_fields.failure: Monotone attractive time-homogeneous irreversible cascades with at most one trigger per labelled component,independent known threshold laws and actual local reset/clamp/timing/measurement service. Positive rate bounds are supplied for acquisition. Main probability/path guarantees require increasing terminal evidence with paid factor/event representation and positive event probability. Numerical width/clock/precision and every acquisition/control cost remain. Synthetic counts are not physical experiments;importance sampling wins a recorded fixture. Internal reviews/independent derivations retain their actual subjects,not unperformed final-code/finite-arithmetic audits. No practical speed advantage or historical priority is established.
